first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates shorter onboarding improves completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. This addresses two current problems without the margin and customer-quality risks of reacting immediately with discounts. Verify memory_86 for downstream revenue evidence and memory_73 to assess whether promotional pricing produced durable qualified revenue rather than primarily short-term lift.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. Verified evidence shows this improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it lifted qualified revenue 18% initially, 30-day retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive its first renewal cycle.
